what: Hovering a card or banner enlarges it slightly to 1.02x over .4s (easeOutCubic 0.215,0.61,0.355,1) and a shadow spreads in over .2s. On release it returns over the same length. The ‹link› type lifts not on the whole card but only when the pointer is over the link inside the card (cover link) — it does not lift over the save button inside the card

options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Growing length and curve (via style), default .4s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)
options.look: If link, only on hover of the inner link (data-fx-lift-shadow-hover="look: link")

use: Find a Lodging…
note: The original uses filter: drop-shadow for the shadow outside the rounded panel. The part lays the skin shadow (--kf-shadow-lift) down as a box-shadow. The rounded corners look the same for the same panel.

from.where: shared.css .mm-card·.mm-tsf-mini·.mm-menu__pokemon, index.css .mm-mv__trip-btn, about.css .mm-amv__trip·.mm-aabout__bnr-link — original .c-card:has(.c-card-link:hover) etc: transform scale(1.02) 400ms power2-out, filter drop-shadow(.4rem .4rem .8rem 12%) 200ms linear
